tasks.title: Announcement #44
tasks.instruction: listen to an announcement at a University Club meeting.
tasks.transcript: Man: I see we have a lot of new members here this evening. Tonight we'll focus on getting to know each other, and starting next week we'll be talking about some exciting new projects, including volunteering at local elementary schools, fundraising for local charities, and planting trees in City Park. I hope you're as excited about giving back to the broader community around our university as I am. I'll start by telling you a bit about myself and then we'll go around the room.

questions.stem: What kind of club is most likely holding the meeting?
questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 正在开会的俱乐部最可能是哪种类型的？ 定位原文: "...including volunteering at local elementary schools, fundraising for local charities, and planting trees in City Park." 选项分析: A. A business club (一个商业俱乐部) - 错误。虽然涉及筹款，但核心是慈善。 B. A theater club (一个戏剧俱乐部) - 错误。与戏剧无关。 C. A tutoring club (一个辅导俱乐部) - 错误。虽然提到了去小学做志愿者，但活动还包括植树和筹款，范围更广。 D. A community service club (一个社区服务俱乐部) - 正确。文中提到的“去小学做志愿者”、“为慈善机构筹款”、“植树”都属于典型的社区服务活动。

options.A: Students will propose new volunteer projects.
options.B: Students will share information about local schools.
options.D: Students will raise funds for student clubs.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 接下来可能会发生什么？ 定位原文: "I'll start by telling you a bit about myself and then we'll go around the room." 选项分析: A. Students will propose new volunteer projects. (学生将提议新的志愿者项目。) - 错误。这是下周的计划。 B. Students will share information about local schools. (学生将分享当地学校的信息。) -错误。这是无关细节。 C. Students will introduce themselves. (学生将进行自我介绍。) - 正确。说话者说 "we'll go around the room"（我们会绕着房间一圈），结合前面的 "telling you a bit about myself"，这是典型的轮流自我介绍的环节。 D. Students will raise funds for student clubs. (学生将为社团筹款。) - 错误。筹款是未来的项目，不是现在的活动。
